title: Assessment of the Prescriber's and the Pharmacies Overview of Patient Medication by Use of the Fidelity Coefficient.
brief_summary: The purpose of this study is to twofold. The investigators wish to introduce a new patient-descriptive parameter, the 'Fidelity Coefficient', and use it to assess and compare the overview of patient's medication possessed by the general practitioners and the pharmacies.
raw_criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* Having filed more than 9 prescriptions during 2009.

Exclusion Criteria:

* None
study_population: Residents of Region of Southern Denmark during 2009.
